title: Photograph: the blessed letter to Muqawqis, ruler of Egypt (Copts)
headingUrdu: تصویر: نامۂ مبارک بنام مقوقس والیِ قبطِ مصر
headingPashto: انځور: مقوقس د مصر د قبطیانو والي ته مبارک لیک

paras.en: Photograph of the blessed letter addressed to Muqawqis, ruler of the Copts of Egypt.
paras.ur: عکسِ نامۂ مبارک بنام مقوقس والیِ قبطِ مصر
paras.ps: د مصر د قبطیانو د والي مقوقس په نوم د مبارک لیک انځور.

sourceNote: Printed page 71: a full-page photograph of the letter of the Prophet to Muqawqis (a white-on-black reproduction with a transcription below it, and the round seal “محمد رسول اللہ”). The photograph and its small Arabic transcription are not reproduced (raster picture, writing not legible enough to copy faithfully); only the printed caption “عکسِ نامۂ مبارک بنام مقوقس والیِ قبطِ مصر” is given. The printed “قسط” is read as “قبط” (Copts). English and Pashto are our translations (need native review); watermark, handwriting, page-edge shadows, a thumb at the page edge and ornamental borders excluded. Scan n = printed page n+1 (file = {p//2:03d}_page_2 for even printed page p, {(p-1)//2:03d}_page_1 for odd p).
